risk_summary: The excerpt provides substantial quantified operating results and clearly explains constant-currency and revenue-recognition measures. Risk disclosure is cautious and heavily qualified around COVID-19, economic recovery, currencies, and strategic alternatives, but much of this language is standard forward-looking-statement boilerplate. Overall performance improved materially, although ongoing pandemic and macroeconomic uncertainty remain meaningful credit risks.
